data.body:
[P2] Validate original-request ordering across refreshes

Sorting each refresh does not preserve native invocation order when ledger publication is delayed. If a retry is collected first, it receives ordinal zero; when the earlier original arrives in another refresh, it receives a retry ordinal and the selected original remains the retry. The missing-stream check then passes because both streams exist, while coordinator ownership checks trust the incorrectly ordered journal. This can validate a successful retry instead of the required original. Reconcile selection against service invocation chronology, or fail collection when newly discovered evidence precedes an already-bound original. Add a regression spanning two refreshes.
